allow: Bash(env | grep -i proxy || echo "无环境代理")
Bash(networksetup -getsocksfirewallproxy Wi-Fi 2>/dev/null || echo "无法获取代理设置")
Bash(networksetup -setsocksfirewallproxystate Wi-Fi off && git push && networksetup -setsocksfirewallproxystate Wi-Fi on)
Bash(networksetup -setsocksfirewallproxystate Wi-Fi off && git pull --no-rebase && git push)
